integrity: Finite-depth claims have replayable complete binary trees with distinct witnesses, separate generation and verification algorithms, and cardinality upper bounds; the all-size assertions follow from structural proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact Littlestone classification is restricted to \(n\le10\). For \(n=10s\) only a lower bound is asserted. Related historical formulations may have escaped the search; external expert audit has not been performed.
